text_block_list.text:
Some time had passed since the 
announcement of the new race series, the 
'URA Finals.'

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The "Finals Champion," huh...! Heh, things 
are getting interesting.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of race we should 
target. Medium distance... no, wait, maybe 
a mile race could work too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to enter medium distances... 
How about you stick to the mile?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because number one in the middle distance 
is mine for the taking♪

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wha...?! You really said it now, punk!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm obviously aiming for middle 
distance too! Let's settle this, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Hmph, just what I wanted!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!! The inaugural champion... A 
title truly fitting for the first-rate 
King to bear!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
N-Now, Sky-san, run alongside me once 
more! I shall grant you the privilege of 
running with King!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aaaalright, you really work an Umamusume 
to the bone, you know.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, on the bright side, it lets us 
check on a bunch of things."

It seems the Umamusume's excitement is 
gradually building up for the URA Finals 
as well.
choice_data_list: (I need to do my best too...!)
(I have to do my best too...!)

text_block_list.text: Just as I was firing myself up again—
(VROOOM VROOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaah!?

Startled, I hurriedly went to check on the 
source of the tremendous noise—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Wh... What...?!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What on earth is this giant vehicle~~~?!

Arriving at the dirt course in a rush, I 
found a flustered Tazuna-san... along 
with,
(VROOOM VROOOOOM!!)
...A gigantic, roaring vehicle (?)...
choice_data_list: What on earth is this situation...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Hahahaha!! Were you so thrilled you had to 
scream, Tazuna?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: What a coincidence!! If it isn't Trainer <username>!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"What a coincidence!! I really wanted to 
talk to you. You see—"

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Please wait, Chairwoman!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First off, could you please explain what 
that massive vehicle is...?

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Pardon me! That's right.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh, about that... prepare to be 
amazed!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Grooming! Instantly smoothing out the 
well-worn dirt! Adjusting! Dialing in the 
sand's depth and weight in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Developed using the very pinnacle of 
technology, its name is the "Dirt 
Maintenance Machine: Cultivator-kun No. 
3"!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of technology...? Don't tell 
me you paid out of pocket again?!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I always want to provide a safe 
training environment for all Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
If it is for that sake, pouring in my 
personal funds is nothing! A trifle! An 
utter, absolute trifle!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy you care, but still~!! Every 
single time, the scale is just way too 
big...!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah... Where on earth am I supposed to 
store a large vehicle of this size...!?
(VROOOM VROOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer. Forgive me for 
showing such an unsightly side of myself."

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
My sincerest apologies! And now, once 
again—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Greetings! It's been a while, Trainer <username>! 
Not since the training seminar, right!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
...Mhm! Yes, yes!! Those eyes, that 
sparkle! That's a great look on you!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Splendid!! That's the man I believed in!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Splendid!! That's the woman I believed 
in!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Chairwoman Akikawa has had her eye 
on you for a while now, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mm. Ever since my predecessor—my 
mother—served as this Academy's 
chairwoman, I have watched over many a 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Therefore! Just by watching your daily 
conduct and how you interact with your 
trainee, I can tell.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Confirmed! As a Trainer— you are a fine 
pillar supporting an Umamusume's dream!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel the exact same way as the 
Chairwoman. That's why I truly hope the 
Trainers will...

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! I would love nothing more than for 
you and your trainee to help make the URA 
Finals a resounding success!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"For a new race to succeed, we truly need 
someone who can shoulder the dreams and 
expectations of countless fans—"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
In other words, the presence of a "Star 
Umamusume" is indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To gain more fans, entering races is an 
absolute necessity.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If we enter lots of races, rack up 
victories, and gather fans—

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Success! Naturally, the path to becoming a 
star Umamusume has now been opened!!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Inspiration! Keep up this momentum and 
forge ahead together with your trainee 
Umamusume!"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
"Now, set your sights on the title of 
inaugural 'Finals Champion,' and run with 
all your might!!"

Feeling Chairwoman Akikawa's passionate 
emotions, my excitement for the URA Finals 
surged once again.
